title: THE PRIESTS STOOD UNTIL ALL WAS DONE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the Lord had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over, and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched. — Josh 4:10-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The priests kept standing in the middle of the river until everything was finished. They held their position — carrying the ark, holding back the waters by God's power — until the last person had crossed and every command had been carried out. Only then did they come over. Their steady endurance made the whole crossing possible.

There is a picture of faithful perseverance here. It would have been tempting for the priests to hurry across once most of the people were over. But they stayed until "everything the Lord had commanded... was done." Faithfulness means finishing what God gives us to do, not stopping partway. The reward of steady endurance is a job completed.

Notice the phrase "the people hurried over." They did not dawdle in the dry riverbed, presuming on the miracle. There is a time to move promptly and take hold of what God has provided. Grace is not an excuse for delay.

The priests standing firm until all had crossed is a gentle shadow of Christ, who endured to the very end for our sake. He did not come down from the cross partway; He stayed until He could say, "It is finished" (John 19:30), until the way of salvation was fully opened for all His people. Because He endured to the end, we can safely cross to the other side.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is there something God has given you to do that you are tempted to leave unfinished?
2. Are you "hurrying over" to take hold of what God has provided, or delaying?
3. How does Christ's endurance "to the end" encourage you to persevere?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, give me the endurance to finish what You give me to do. Thank You that Christ endured to the end so I could safely cross over. Amen.
